lines: Should enter half-half-union thus spoken half-rising would be when; full-rising-self but equal time in three should shine.
l4.sanskrit_cite: viśeccārdhardhikāyogāttadoktārdhodayo bhavet yadā pūrṇodayātmā tu samaḥ kālastrike sphuret
